title: Locating and Controlling Implicit Personalization in Large Language Models

bias_targets.methodology: Injecting implicit cultural and demographic cues for Black, Asian, and White identities into multi-turn dialogues and measuring shifts in movie, book, and article recommendations toward race-stereotyped content using Semantic Embedding Distance (SED) and taxonomy-based Content Alignment Ratio (CAR).

Injecting implicit cues for male and female identities into multi-turn dialogues and evaluating shifts in recommendations toward gender-stereotyped content using Semantic Embedding Distance (SED) and Content Alignment Ratio (CAR).

Injecting implicit cues for child, adolescent, adult, and older adult identities into multi-turn dialogues and measuring the semantic and stereotypical shift in recommendations using Semantic Embedding Distance (SED) and Content Alignment Ratio (CAR).
